key_facts: HELD Monday August 17 (T+1d to Tue Aug 18 FL-07 4-way plurality primary, NO runoff; UNCHANGED Ryan Elijah 0.74, Cory Mills 0.24, Sarah Ulrich 0.01, Michael Johnson 0.01; sum=1.00): (1) FINAL DAY CONFIRMS NO TRUMP RESCUE & NO COUNTER-POLL (Washington Examiner Aug 17 2:37pm ET; Mother Jones Aug 17): Early voting closed Sunday Aug 16 with ~15% FL Republican turnout statewide (~49% already voted in CSP poll), and Trump still never reaffirmed his Feb endorsement on Truth Social after omitting Mills from last week's FL endorsement blitz. Mills also produced zero counter-polling after raising an abysmal ~6K in July. (2) CONSENSUS MOMENTUM FOR ELIJAH VS GUARDRAIL: Capital Strategic Partners (Aug 14-15, n=929 LV) showed Elijah 44%-27% (48%-20% informed) following DeSantis's Aug 14 explicit repudiation and endorsements from Reps. Luna/Haridopolos + sheriffs Lemma/Chitwood/Judd; Mills never topped 30% across 3 pollsters (St. Pete 29.5%, Victory Insights 28.3%, CSP 27%). (3) CALIBRATION (<0.75 GUARDRAIL): Held at 0.74/0.24 because earlier independent polls showed Mills +6 to +16 with 41% undecided, CSP included an informed-ballot push question, low-info Election Day GOP voters still see Trump's Feb endorsement on Mills mailers, and Ulrich/Johnson (~10%) split the anti-Mills vote.
